sources.name: RxNorm – National Library of Medicine
sources.owner: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health (NIH)
sources.terms_and_license: Free for use in non-commercial and commercial systems; subject to UMLS licensing terms for third-party vocabularies.
sources.geographical_coverage: United States standardized clinical drug concepts with international generic mapping.
sources.update_frequency: Monthly full releases, weekly concept updates.
sources.api_requirements: Public REST API (https://rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/REST). No API key required for core concept lookups.
sources.usage_method: Direct REST HTTP GET with JSON response parsing and local caching.

sources.name: openFDA Drug Product Registry & Adverse Events
sources.terms_and_license: Public domain (Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal equivalent). Open Government Data.
sources.geographical_coverage: United States FDA approved pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter drugs, and imported products.
sources.update_frequency: Weekly to quarterly depending on endpoint.
sources.api_requirements: Public REST API (https://api.fda.gov/drug/). Optional OPENFDA_API_KEY for higher query limits.
sources.usage_method: Direct REST HTTP GET with structured parameter filtering. Adverse event frequency does not indicate clinical causation.

sources.name: DailyMed Structured Product Labels
sources.owner: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) in collaboration with the FDA
sources.terms_and_license: Public domain official U.S. government pharmaceutical labeling.
sources.geographical_coverage: United States approved prescription, OTC, and biological products.
sources.update_frequency: Daily / weekly updates upon new manufacturer submissions.
sources.api_requirements: Public REST API (https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/services/v2/). No API key required.
sources.usage_method: REST HTTP GET with JSON parsing for structured labeling monographs.

sources.name: NCBI PubChem Chemical & Pharmacology Database
sources.owner: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), National Library of Medicine
sources.terms_and_license: Public domain chemical registry; individual data contributions respect source terms.
sources.geographical_coverage: Global chemical compounds, bioassays, and active pharmaceutical substances.
sources.api_requirements: PubChem PUG REST API (https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/). No API key required. Rate limited to 5 req/sec.
sources.usage_method: PUG REST GET queries with exponential backoff and caching.

sources.name: Indian Pharmaceutical Regulatory & Manufacturer Catalog
sources.owner: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt of India & Official Product Monographs
sources.terms_and_license: Public health drug safety schedules (Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945), official package inserts.
sources.geographical_coverage: India (National territory, Schedule H/H1, OTC, and major exports).
sources.update_frequency: Periodic gazette updates, CDSCO notices, and manufacturer packaging updates.
sources.api_requirements: Curated regulatory indexing, manufacturer official monographs (Sun Pharma, Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Mankind, Abbott India, Alembic, Torrent, Lupin, Zydus, Intas, Micro Labs).
sources.usage_method: Structured offline index with online regulatory monograph fallback.

sources.name: MediScan AI Curated Clinical Reference Database
sources.owner: MediScan AI Medical Intelligence Engineering Team
sources.terms_and_license: Educational and Clinical Decision Support Research License.
sources.geographical_coverage: Global & Indian priority pharmaceutical market references.
sources.api_requirements: Local SQLite cache (medicine_cache.db) and JSON registry (medicine_metadata.json). Zero network dependency.
sources.usage_method: Direct zero-latency SQLite query and JSON lookup.
